annotations.evidence: the maintainer's print read 2026-10-22: "As above, print/scan issue, the letter is neither a complete yod or vav, based on other evidence vav is correct." Its alternates are `אַוְונָא, אֲוָונָא`; the I pairs it with A00719 `אֲוָנָא II` (Avana, `v. foreg.`); A00749 (`cmp. אֲוָנָא`, linked here) spells it with a vav; it stands between A00717 `אוֹן` and A00719, and under `אי` it would stand pages later. 28a · leaf 51.

senses.gloss: m. (v. foreg. ws.; cmp. גנן, חָנָה, חוּן, a. עוֹנָה, מָעוֹן) [circle], night-lodging, station for travellers (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Mansio).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 79b">B. Mets. 79ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65a:15">Ab. Zar. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מא׳ לא׳</he> from station to station.—

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6">Deut. R. s. 6</cite> she dared to bring disorder into <he>אוננא של מלך</he> (read <he>אוונא</he> or <cite ref="A00582"><he>אַוְונָה</he></cite>, v. infra) the royal head quarters. Pl. <he>אַוְונִין</he>, <he>אֲוָונִין</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 10:32">Targ. Is. X, 32</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="A00743"><he>אַוְנִין</he></cite>).
